keywords: The Petitioner sought to challenge the decision of the 3rd Respondent on the complaint of the 4th Respondent taken while arbitration proceedings were pending before the arbitrator appointed under Section 4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act No 43 of 1950 (as amended); interpretation of the collective agreement. Held - separate application made under Section 10A of the Act is unjustified; legitimate expectation entertained by the Petitioners. Writs issued.
